expectedIssues: Loading spinner is shown on top of already loaded content
reportedIssues: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now' shows a circular loading spinner centered on top of a fully rendered (but dimmed/blurred) food image. The card's text, rating, delivery info and '€0 delivery' badge are already loaded, so the persistent spinner looks like a stuck/failed image load rather than an intentional state.
The image behind the spinner is noticeably darkened/blurred compared to the pizza card below it, creating an inconsistent look between two adjacent cards in the same list.
The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a very light gray fill, giving low contrast that may fail WCAG 1.4.3 for users with low vision.

Cards in 'Fastest near you' show only name and delivery fee, while 'Popular right now' cards show rating, time, fee and cuisine. The absence of ratings/cuisine in the first row makes the two sections feel inconsistent and gives users less decision-making info.
The first carousel tile (Green Bowl Poké) uses a light/white photo background while the adjacent tiles use dark backgrounds, producing a visually uneven row.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 describes a spinner over an already rendered card image and loaded content.
